references.publisher: Région Pays de la Loire, Inventaire Général
references.observations: Tuffeau ashlar; main range, two quadrangular towers and unequal return wings. Two upper floors plus attic in main range; towers have an additional level. Historical pavilion roofs on square towers have disappeared. Western polygonal stair has pointed slate roof. Eastern Renaissance stair dates to 1510–1530 and has a flat terrace with two rows of slate discs. Photographs show four river dormers, three courtyard dormers, stone cross windows, machicolations, narrow chimney stacks, steep slate roof and lower western shed roof. Stair photograph resolves paired openings without cross transoms, carved pilasters and figurative panels. Those sculptures are not yet modeled. No measured plan or section inspected; Salleron 1886–88 reference describes a north exterior view.

references.publisher: Château de Montsoreau – Musée d’art contemporain
references.observations: Owner describes fifteenth-century construction, 45 cross windows, 25 fireplaces and a 17 m great hall. Published 35 m terrace height has no clear vertical datum and is not a surveyed model height. The 25 fireplaces are not a count of roof chimney stacks. River panorama inspected.
National heritage inventory record; regional dossier and exterior photographs used for reconstruction.
